policy: One canonical content owner, multiple contextual projections; no copied texts.
Keep existing published routes and old aliases valid.
Never turn map/place data, canonical Mass data or Calendar computations into second owners.
Cross-surface handoffs preserve origin/selection/scroll and return on error.
Presentation classification is proposed; not an independent publication certificate.

groups.note: End-of-life subsection is inside devotions, not another equal homepage tile.

pray.rule: Display groupings overlay the current six families; do not modify canonical ownership or player identifiers.

formation.note: Scripture and Glossary are contextual services, not an extra permanent tab. Question view can project catechism questions without duplicating canonical Q&A.

link_integrity_findings.issue: Apostolate calendar targets rejected by current handoff surface allow-list.
link_integrity_findings.remediation: Extend the existing handler to permit the calendar canonical route, preserving return state; validate in phone journey. Do not add new Calendar module.

link_integrity_findings.issue: Apostolate references a Marian Prayer route not present in the 23-route Prayer presentation registry.
link_integrity_findings.remediation: Resolve the intended canonical existing prayer/route (e.g. Rosary or Prayer Library detail) and verify return. Do not create a parallel Marian module.

link_integrity_findings.issue: Apostolate references a Holy Souls Prayer route not present in the 23-route Prayer presentation registry.
link_integrity_findings.remediation: Resolve to an existing specific Prayer Library item or registered route using canonical prayer ID; do not invent a new route.
